# MTMamba attribution

The joint-task backbone, decoder, losses and evaluation utilities are adapted
from [MTMamba](https://github.com/EnVision-Research/MTMamba). LiFR adds event
propagation, memory and completion; its entry points and configuration format
are documented in [the root README](../../README.md#training).

The upstream repository did not provide an overall LICENSE file when checked.
This attribution does not grant redistribution permission. Obtain the authors'
permission before redistributing portions without an applicable license.
Retained file-specific notices, including CC BY-NC 4.0 notices, continue to apply.
